fields.name: Audio & Wearables
fields.description: High-fidelity spatial audio, active noise cancellation, and smart wearable tech.

fields.name: Workstation & Tech
fields.description: Ergonomic furniture, high-refresh displays, and mechanical desk accessories.

fields.name: Smart Home & Living
fields.description: Minimalist home decor, smart ambient lighting, and artisanal lifestyle goods.

fields.name: Lifestyle & Gear
fields.description: Premium waterproof everyday carry, Merino wool apparel, and travel gear.

fields.name: Gaming & Studio
fields.description: Retro gaming gear, studio recording mics, and immersive spatial hardware.

fields.name: AuraSound Pro Wireless Headphones
fields.description: Experience uncompromised acoustics with adaptive active noise cancellation, 40-hour battery life, and spatial audio drivers calibrated by master sound engineers.

fields.name: Nova Earbuds Ultra
fields.description: Compact, powerful wireless earbuds with IPX7 waterproof rating, Hi-Res LDAC audio codec, and intuitive touch gesture controls.

fields.name: Pulse V2 Smart Spatial Watch
fields.description: Titanium alloy bezel smart watch featuring vibrant Always-On AMOLED screen, continuous ECG monitoring, blood oxygen telemetry, and 7-day battery endurance.

fields.name: SonicBar Acoustic Soundbar
fields.description: Sleek low-profile home theater soundbar delivering 3D Dolby Atmos sound stage with wireless subwoofer support.

fields.name: Vibe Studio Reference Headphones
fields.description: Flat-frequency studio monitor headphones engineered for sound mixing, audio editing, and pristine acoustic reproduction.

fields.name: Zenith Audio Smart Frames
fields.description: Revolutionary open-ear audio sunglasses with polarized UV400 lenses and directional speaker micro-arrays.

fields.name: Spectra 34" Curved Ultrawide OLED Display
fields.description: Ultra-immersive 175Hz 0.03ms response curved OLED monitor with DCI-P3 99% color gamut and USB-C 90W power delivery.

fields.name: Apex Pro Custom Mechanical Keyboard
fields.description: Gasket-mounted custom mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable tactile switches, double-shot PBT keycaps, and customizable RGB backlight.

fields.name: ErgoLift Electric Standing Desk Frame
fields.description: Dual-motor motorized sit-stand desk frame with whisper-quiet operation, anti-collision sensor, and 4 memory height presets.

fields.name: Lumino LED Task Lamp & Qi Charger
fields.description: Architectural LED desk lamp with auto-brightness sensor, 5 color temperature modes, and integrated 15W wireless smartphone charger.

fields.name: Precision Wireless Ergonomic Mouse
fields.description: Sculpted ergonomic wireless mouse featuring ultra-fast MagSpeed electromagnetic scrolling and an 8000 DPI track-anywhere optical sensor.

fields.name: FlexiArm Heavy Duty Dual Monitor Mount
fields.description: Gas spring dual monitor arm supporting monitors up to 32" each, with full 360-degree rotation and integrated cable routing.

fields.name: Aura Glow Ambient Light Bar Pair
fields.description: Smart RGBIC light bars that dynamically sync color illumination to your music, movies, or gaming setups.

fields.name: Nebula Ultrasonic Aroma Diffuser
fields.description: Handcrafted ceramic ultrasonic mist diffuser with soft ambient warm glow lighting and safety auto-shutoff.

fields.name: Artisan Precision Coffee Dripper Set
fields.description: Hand-blown heat resistant borosilicate glass pour-over coffee carafe with reusable ultra-fine stainless steel mesh filter.

fields.name: Puria HEPA Air Purifier Pro
fields.description: Medical grade True HEPA H13 filtration system removing 99.97% of airborne allergens, dust, smoke, and odors.

fields.name: Chronos E-Ink Minimalist Desk Clock
fields.description: High-contrast glanceable E-Ink digital desk clock equipped with precision temperature and ambient humidity sensors.

fields.name: Hydra UV-C Smart Water Bottle 750ml
fields.description: Self-cleaning insulated water bottle equipped with built-in UV-C purification cap and digital water temperature indicator.

fields.name: AeroTech Waterproof Commuter Backpack 24L
fields.description: Ultra-durable Cordura ballistic nylon travel backpack featuring padded 16" laptop chamber, hidden RFID security pocket, and weatherproof seal.

fields.name: Titan Minimalist Aluminum Card Wallet
fields.description: RFID-blocking aerospace aluminum slim wallet with smooth mechanical trigger lever for instant single-handed card extraction.

fields.name: CloudSoft Merino Wool Tech Hoodie
fields.description: Superfine 100% Australian Merino wool zip hoodie engineered for natural temperature regulation, odor resistance, and supreme softness.

fields.name: Nomad Vacuum Thermal Tumbler 500ml
fields.description: Double-wall stainless steel travel mug featuring 100% leak-proof magnetic slider lid and non-slip silicone base.

fields.name: Luxe Leather Journal & Brass Pen Set
fields.description: Full-grain Italian leather refillable notebook cover paired with a solid weighted brass rollerball fountain-pen.

fields.name: Urban Shield Compact Anti-Theft Sling Bag
fields.description: Ergonomic crossbody sling bag built with cut-proof fabric layer, lockable anti-theft zipper pullers, and external USB charging port.

fields.name: RetroCam X1 4K Digital Camera
fields.description: Vintage-inspired mirrorless digital camera combining classic tactile aluminum dials with modern 24MP APS-C sensor and 4K 60fps video recording.

fields.name: PocketDeck OLED Handheld Gaming Console
fields.description: Portable PC gaming handheld featuring a gorgeous 7" HDR OLED touch display, custom 8-core APU, and tactile ergonomic thumbsticks.

fields.name: StudioCraft USB Studio Condenser Mic
fields.description: Broadcast-quality USB condenser microphone featuring 24-bit 96kHz audio resolution, dual polar patterns, and zero-latency headphone monitoring.

fields.name: GamerCore Wireless Mechanical Arcade Stick
fields.description: Tournament-grade fighting stick equipped with authentic Sanwa Denshi joystick & buttons, ultra-low latency 2.4G wireless, and magnetic lid access.

fields.name: ProStream Monitor RGB Lightbar Dial
fields.description: Asymmetric optical monitor bar lighting up your desk surface without screen glare, complete with a wireless desktop control puck dial.

fields.name: VR-Pulse 4K Spatial Gaming Headset
fields.description: Next-gen standalone VR headset featuring dual 4K Micro-OLED displays, pancake lenses, and optical hand-tracking camera array.
